reason: I'm 65, I have my tab at the dekkene and I'm in the Jbeil supermarkets anyway when I go. Paying $2 a bag to have someone shop for me, then driving to a pickup point in the evening, saves me nothing.
objection: I'm a few minutes from Tawfeer, why would I pay someone to shop for me? And I still have to go collect the bag myself, there is no delivery.
would_change_my_mind: Delivery to my door with no fee, or proof that the carton prices come out clearly cheaper than what I pay at Tawfeer, enough to cover the fee.
